items.caption:
Dream about being late for an exam: what science says.
67% of students in one survey had dreamed about school. In France, about 700 medical students' exam dreams mostly went wrong, yet dreaming of the exam went with slightly better grades.

items.caption:
Two months in a cave. He thought one.
In 1962 Michel Siffre lived alone in a cave with no clock and no daylight. When his team came for him on September 14, he thought it was August 20.

items.caption:
These birds sleep while flying.
Brain recordings of wild great frigatebirds showed sleep in flight, in short bouts, about 42 minutes a day, often with one half of the brain awake.
